decision: Changes required. Do not integrate as independently cleared. The DIM evidence correction is sound, but production-source masking introduces a demonstrated false negative and fails to exclude another ordinary test-module form.
method: Separate sparse source archive with dedicated target, no author worktree changes. Independent regression probes were appended only to the review-owned test artifact, then exact candidate bytes restored. All Rust execution used cargo nextest inside owned process groups with 210-second deadlines. No production behavior, labels, snapshots, expected outputs, references, or keys changed.

findings.problem: An external test-module declaration (`#[cfg(test)] mod tests;`) is treated as the start of an inline module. The unbounded search for the next opening brace consumes the following production item and masks its contents. A genuine invalid hint in the next production function is silently omitted, so the acceptance gate can pass with a non-verb production label.
findings.reproduction: Input: #[cfg(test)]\nmod tests;\nfn production() { hint("Esc", "Unexpected label"); }. Before this change the scanner returns one invalid label; candidate returns zero. Independent assertion expected1, actual0. External cfg(test) module declarations already occur at tablepro-ui/src/app.rs:31, termrock-shell/src/nav.rs:353, and termrock-shell/src/router.rs:518; the TablePro declaration currently masks a following grouped use item.
findings.required_change: Parse the complete module declaration boundary; distinguish an external semicolon declaration from an inline opening brace, and never search past the current item into a later one. Add the independent regression fixture and verify that a following production hint still fails validation.

findings.problem: A normal additional attribute between cfg(test) and an inline module prevents masking. `#[cfg(test)] #[allow(dead_code)] mod tests { ... }` is retained as production source and its fixture label fails the gate, reproducing the original class of false positive.
findings.reproduction: Input has cfg(test), allow(dead_code), a test module containing hint("Esc", "Fixture only"), then production hint("Esc", "Close"). Expected labels [Close], actual [Fixture only, Close].
findings.required_change: Recognize the complete attribute list and supported module syntax instead of requiring immediate literal `mod `. Preserve code following the module and add focused fixtures for external modules, stacked attributes, visibility, and normal Rust whitespace.

accepted_parts.baseline_exception: Only exact label Keep launching at jackin-preview-app/src/app/launch_cockpit.rs is exempted; gate checks exactly two occurrences. Different labels at that path and the same label elsewhere are rejected. Frozen source 4169783 src/widgets/dialog.rs:1987-1997 explicitly tests the visible Escape hint, and no production labels are changed. The static commit/assertion constants document evidence; they do not dynamically verify frozen Git contents.
accepted_parts.dim_addendum: Accurately withdraws the earlier component-specific oracle conclusion, distinguishes mutable candidate Harness digest from frozen CLI output, states no fresh capture occurred, preserves the old report, and retains the already-cleared DIM behavior. No production source files were changed by this commit.
